context.content_translation:
随着新的网站增强功能，Gym Hill Street Design的客户将能够查看最近购买的-------。
A. voucher
B. coupon
C. summary
D. payment

items.question: With the new Web site enhancements, Gym Hill Street Design customers will be able to view a ------- of recent purchases.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“summary”代入题干后为“With the new Web site enhancements, Gym Hill Street Design customers will be able to view a summary of recent purchases.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：C（summary）。
